why: Single-channel release plumbing before v3 lands: the shim goes, master's CI must be green to release, a release needs a package commit, commitlint covers the range and the marketing deploy is path-scoped. 2.8.0 shipped on a red master.
what: .github/workflows/{release,ci,deploy}.yml, scripts/release.sh library half (CI-green preflight, no-package-commit refusal) and scripts/release.test.ts. publish.yml keeps `npm publish --access public`: master publishes to latest, the only channel. version_gate, BRANCH and the dispatch flow stay untouched. v3-charts-bump files --after this Issue (shared bun.lock).
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 4.1 step 1, 4.3 and docs/v3/evidence/gap-repo-surface-release-proof.md 2.5, 2.6 (preflight query). Insufficient contract: factory signal, reversible default, PR body says so. Frozen contracts are read-only.
change: (1) CI-green preflight: the newest non-release first-parent commit's CI run must be completed/success. After the dry run, refuse when `git log <last v* tag>..origin/master -- packages/basalt-ui` is empty (the dropped path filter's replacement). (2) release.yml: plain ./node_modules/.bin/semantic-release; drop `node -r`, MONOREPO_DIR and semantic-release-monorepo (root package.json, bun.lock). (3) ci.yml: fetch-depth 0 and commitlint over the range: pull_request `--from <base.sha> --to <head.sha>`; push `--from <event.before> --to <sha>`, and for a new-branch push (before is 40 zeros) `--from origin/master --to HEAD`. (4) deploy.yml: push paths ['apps/marketing/**','.github/workflows/deploy.yml'] plus workflow_dispatch; rewrite only the 'Every master push' comment paragraph. No dist-tag logic: publish.yml and await_registry stay as they are. Tests in release.test.ts; no lint rule or skill snippet.
commits: One PR, `ci:` commits, non-package only (no isolation split). No attribution.
proof: bun test scripts/release.test.ts; ci.yml green on the PR. Reviewed deep.
acceptance: bun test scripts/release.test.ts passes: a stubbed gh refusing a non-success run, the no-package-commit refusal, and every existing version_gate case unchanged.
grep -rnE 'semantic-release-monorepo|node -r|MONOREPO_DIR' .github package.json bun.lock returns nothing; bun install --frozen-lockfile exits 0.
ci.yml has fetch-depth: 0 and the commitlint --from/--to forms; deploy.yml has the paths filter and workflow_dispatch.
grep -n 'dist_tag_for' scripts/release.sh .github/workflows/publish.yml returns nothing and publish.yml's publish line is unchanged.
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD shows nothing under packages/basalt-ui/ or .releaserc.json.
out_of_scope: The gate rewrite, BRANCH selection, doctrine text (rel-5).
